mostWorthwhile.text: Making the epidermal barrier was most worthwhile: the description connected water retention with continual replacement of shed cells, making the surface feel living rather than static.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the sweat gland was straightforward but offered no further explanation; assembling the coil and duct was also predictable.

surprise.text: The renewal detail changed my understanding of the barrier from a static covering to a layer continually replenished from below.

arbitrary.text: No combination felt arbitrary: the named slots and picture descriptions gave each a clear purpose. The sensory endings' connection to the nervous system was stated, though the kinds of sensation were not explained.

continue.text: I would probably not continue personally: the constructions were coherent, but several fittings were predictable and offered little explanation beyond the planned picture descriptions.
